answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 22 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The wharf debit happens at intake, prism totals the burned amount, and cedar anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 277 pays that 274 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
